import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,stream,crypto,datagram,trace
from h import run
def T(events,**kw): return run({"traces":[trace(events,**kw)]})['traces'][0]
def ncid(seq,rpt,cid,token=b'\x11'*16): return bytes([0x18])+v(seq)+v(rpt)+bytes([len(cid)])+cid+token
def retire(seq): return bytes([0x19])+v(seq)
def P(r,w=''):
    print('---',w); print(json.dumps(r['packets']))
    print('closed',json.dumps(r['closed']))
    print('peer_cids',json.dumps(r['peer_cids']),'rpt',r['retire_prior_to'],'retired_local',json.dumps(r['retired_local']))

# new cid seq 1
r=T([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,ncid(1,0,b'\xdd'),auth=0) if False else envelope('A',0,ncid(1,0,b'\xdd')),auth=[0])]); P(r,'ncid1')
# ncid seq 1 different cid later -> PROTOCOL_VIOLATION
evs=[{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,ncid(1,0,b'\xdd')),auth=[0]),datagram(envelope('A',1,ncid(1,0,b'\xee')),auth=[0])]
r=T(evs); P(r,'ncid1 conflicting')
# cid reuse across sequences
evs=[{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,ncid(1,0,b'\xdd')),auth=[0]),datagram(envelope('A',1,ncid(2,0,b'\xdd')),auth=[0])]
r=T(evs); P(r,'cid reuse')
